notes: AMD Dual-CCD 3D V-Cache Protection: Automatically detects 7900X3D, 7950X3D, 9900X3D, and 9950X3D processors and preserves core parking to keep game threads locked on the 3D V-Cache CCD
Multiplane Overlay (MPO) Bypass: Added advanced control (OverlayTestMode = 5) to eliminate VRR/G-Sync flicker, micro-stutters, and black screen driver freezes during Alt-Tabbing
Windowed Game Optimizations: Enabled Windows DirectFlip (SwapEffectUpgradeEnable) to bypass Desktop Window Manager (DWM) composition latency in borderless windowed mode
GPU Shader Cache Safety & Audit: Shifted shader cache cleaning to Caution with recompilation stutter warnings, strictly scoped to compiled driver cache directories
Safe EmptyWorkingSet Filtering: Pre-Game Boost now protects active games, the foreground application window, and critical system/audio processes from RAM trimming
Read-Only Game Config Handling: Config optimizer and restore seamlessly handle write-protected files without error or permission failures
UI/UX Polish: Current → Target value pills with human-readable labels, friendly startup display names, live telemetry subtitles, and high-contrast icons
